from pathlib import Path
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def mode(seq):
        return Counter(seq).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_modes = [mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    rlines = [r for r,v in enumerate(row_modes) if v != bg]
    clines = [c for c,v in enumerate(col_modes) if v != bg]
    line_color = Counter([row_modes[r] for r in rlines] + [col_modes[c] for c in clines]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [(ri,ci) for ri,r in enumerate(rlines) for ci,c in enumerate(clines) if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not active:
        return []
    r0=min(x[0] for x in active); r1=max(x[0] for x in active)
    c0=min(x[1] for x in active); c1=max(x[1] for x in active)
    rr=rlines[r0:r1+1]; cc=clines[c0:c1+1]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rr)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cc)-1):
            corners=[grid[rr[i]][cc[j]],grid[rr[i]][cc[j+1]],grid[rr[i+1]][cc[j]],grid[rr[i+1]][cc[j+1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners))==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-8adccec3.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
print(p)
